breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the conflicting definitions for the grid. The incomplete prompt provided a standard preamble for grid conventions and then added a contradictory instruction to use `dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`. The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction and followed the standard convention for a periodic domain `[a,b)`, which was also specified in section 7 of the prompt. The generated specification correctly states 'The spatial step size dx is 1/Nx', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
